status: The Dungeons playable; The Fallen redesign remains next

walter.name: Walter
walter.role: Stoneworker who knows how the prison was rebuilt

sly.name: Sly
sly.role: A prisoner who stole from someone worse off

kd.walter.first.text: You're not wearing their colors. That will upset the management. I'm Walter. I used to mend these walls. Now I sleep beside them. Read the list at the stairs, then look in the west cells. The guards' numbers don't match the beds.

choices.text: Where did they move everyone?
Can we get people out of here?

voice.speaker: walter
voice.scene: A builder notices what the guards tried to hide
voice.emotion: Male. Older, steady, dry humor. Observant rather than mysterious.
voice.direction: Male. Older, steady, dry humor. Observant rather than mysterious.
voice.context: The Dungeons below Ruined Keep. The player is freeing captives and will learn Ellis escaped north. No Bladeborn or ending reveal. A builder notices what the guards tried to hide

kd.walter.marks.text: They built a false wall behind the empty cells. Old service marks still show where the passage ran. Follow those. Stone can hide a doorway, but it can't explain why the floor keeps going through it.

choices.text: What about the lift?
The papers mention Professor Ellis.

voice.speaker: walter
voice.scene: An optional clue to the hidden holding room
voice.emotion: Matter-of-fact pride in knowing his trade. Clear directions without naming every turn.
voice.direction: Matter-of-fact pride in knowing his trade. Clear directions without naming every turn.
voice.context: The Dungeons below Ruined Keep. The player is freeing captives and will learn Ellis escaped north. No Bladeborn or ending reveal. An optional clue to the hidden holding room

kd.walter.lift.text: The lift carries people to the upper shelter. Its load plate shows four. Hook weights that add up to four; leave the others off. Free the people first. They'll gather on the platform while you work. The eastern service stairs let you follow or come back down.

choices.text: I will find the missing prisoners.
What do you know about Ellis?

voice.speaker: walter
voice.scene: The required puzzle and return route
voice.emotion: Patient, like explaining a tool to someone who needs it now.
voice.direction: Patient, like explaining a tool to someone who needs it now.
voice.context: The Dungeons below Ruined Keep. The player is freeing captives and will learn Ellis escaped north. No Bladeborn or ending reveal. The required puzzle and return route

kd.walter.ellis.text: Ellis worked on the King's early research. They wanted him back, badly. He escaped north before the last transport. The people you found heard the guards arguing about the frozen mountains. Frostfell. If he knows how this began, he might know what we can do next.

choices.text: Does he know where the King is?
What is beyond the upper shelter?

voice.speaker: walter
voice.scene: The next destination comes from rescued people and papers
voice.emotion: Hope, cautiously earned. No claim that Ellis knows the final answer.
voice.direction: Hope, cautiously earned. No claim that Ellis knows the final answer.
voice.context: The Dungeons below Ruined Keep. The player is freeing captives and will learn Ellis escaped north. No Bladeborn or ending reveal. The next destination comes from rescued people and papers

kd.walter.unknown.text: I don't know. Neither do the guards who work down here. But someone who helped with the first experiments knows more than a stoneworker with a cracked hammer. Start with what we have.

choices.text: Then I need the way out.

voice.speaker: walter
voice.scene: Keeps the castle location a secret
voice.emotion: Honest uncertainty. No coy refusal or invented hidden knowledge.
voice.direction: Honest uncertainty. No coy refusal or invented hidden knowledge.
voice.context: The Dungeons below Ruined Keep. The player is freeing captives and will learn Ellis escaped north. No Bladeborn or ending reveal. Keeps the castle location a secret

kd.walter.fallen.text: The Fallen guards the release hall. Used to be a champion. Now it stands there waiting for orders. We'll stay in the upper shelter until the hall is clear. You've done enough carrying for one day; let us keep ourselves out of trouble.

choices.text: Stay together.

voice.speaker: walter
voice.emotion: Serious, then quiet gratitude. Never identify the champion as Bladeborn.
voice.direction: Serious, then quiet gratitude. Never identify the champion as Bladeborn.
voice.context: The Dungeons below Ruined Keep. The player is freeing captives and will learn Ellis escaped north. No Bladeborn or ending reveal. Warns of the final obstacle

kd.sly.first.text: A rescue? Lovely. I was starting to think my appeal had been filed under 'never.' Call me Sly. Before we leave, I may need help returning something. A small something. With a chain on it.

choices.text: Whose is it?
I am looking for the hidden prisoners.

voice.speaker: sly
voice.emotion: Male. Quick charm covering shame; do not make him a cartoon villain.
voice.direction: Male. Quick charm covering shame; do not make him a cartoon villain.
voice.context: The Dungeons below Ruined Keep. The player is freeing captives and will learn Ellis escaped north. No Bladeborn or ending reveal. A thief tests the waters

kd.sly.busy.text: So am I, in a less useful way. Walter knows these walls. I know which guards kick first. His knowledge is probably more helpful just now.

choices.text: About that chain...

voice.speaker: sly
voice.emotion: A quick dry joke, then back off.
voice.direction: A quick dry joke, then back off.
voice.context: The Dungeons below Ruined Keep. The player is freeing captives and will learn Ellis escaped north. No Bladeborn or ending reveal. Main rescue remains independent

kd.sly.truth.text: A man in the hidden cells kept a little picture of his family on it. I took that and a purple shard while he slept. Thought I could trade them for a way out. Turns out there's a price for being that sort of person, too.

choices.text: Return his picture. Make it right, and I will keep this between us.

effects.title: A picture on a chain
effects.text: Return the stolen keepsake to its owner in the hidden holding room. Sly has agreed to make amends. Then speak to him again.

choices.text: He deserves an apology, not another secret.

effects.title: An honest return
effects.text: Return the family keepsake in the hidden holding room. Sly has agreed to admit what he did. Speak to him afterward.

choices.text: Hand it over. I could sell it myself.

effects.title: An empty collar
effects.text: Sly says the owner keeps reaching for the chain he lost. The keepsake can still be returned in the hidden holding room.

voice.speaker: sly
voice.scene: A meaningful choice about making amends
voice.emotion: The charm drops. Quiet shame, no demand for pity.
voice.direction: The charm drops. Quiet shame, no demand for pity.
voice.context: The Dungeons below Ruined Keep. The player is freeing captives and will learn Ellis escaped north. No Bladeborn or ending reveal. A meaningful choice about making amends

kd.sly.quiet.text: All right. Put the picture back in his bundle once he's free. I'll carry his things out and tell him I owe him a favor. Several favors. If you're going to let me be better, I'd better actually do it.

choices.text: His picture is back where it belongs.
I will return it.

voice.speaker: sly
voice.emotion: Reluctant sincerity. The player is not excusing the theft.
voice.direction: Reluctant sincerity. The player is not excusing the theft.
voice.context: The Dungeons below Ruined Keep. The player is freeing captives and will learn Ellis escaped north. No Bladeborn or ending reveal. A quiet restitution route

kd.sly.open.text: You're right. Horrible habit, being right. Put it in his bundle and I'll tell him who took it. Then he can decide whether I carry his pack or walk well ahead of him.

choices.text: The picture is back. Keep your word.
I will find his bundle.

voice.speaker: sly
voice.context: The Dungeons below Ruined Keep. The player is freeing captives and will learn Ellis escaped north. No Bladeborn or ending reveal. An open apology route

kd.sly.angry.text: I was hoping you were better than me. He's still reaching for that empty chain around his neck. Funny, the things your hands remember. I haven't much else to say to you.

choices.text: I put the picture back. I was wrong.
I will think about it.

voice.speaker: sly
voice.scene: Selfish choice closes cooperation until actual repair
voice.emotion: Disappointed and curt. The empty-chain observation is the repair clue, not a task demand.
voice.direction: Disappointed and curt. The empty-chain observation is the repair clue, not a task demand.
voice.context: The Dungeons below Ruined Keep. The player is freeing captives and will learn Ellis escaped north. No Bladeborn or ending reveal. Selfish choice closes cooperation until actual repair

kd.sly.repair.text: You went back. Good. Then I'll stop using your bad answer as an excuse for mine. I'll tell him. And you should take the shard somewhere it can do some good.

choices.text: Then we both keep our word.

voice.speaker: sly
voice.emotion: Surprised relief. A small chance to be decent again.
voice.direction: Surprised relief. A small chance to be decent again.
voice.context: The Dungeons below Ruined Keep. The player is freeing captives and will learn Ellis escaped north. No Bladeborn or ending reveal. Repair through action, before departure

kd.sly.quiet.reward.text: Here's the purple piece. No trade this time. I helped him onto the lift and he thanked me. That felt worse than being shouted at. Maybe it was supposed to.

choices.text: Keep helping him.

voice.speaker: sly
voice.emotion: Soft, thoughtful. Do not turn the moment into a punchline.
voice.direction: Soft, thoughtful. Do not turn the moment into a punchline.
voice.context: The Dungeons below Ruined Keep. The player is freeing captives and will learn Ellis escaped north. No Bladeborn or ending reveal. Quiet route reward

kd.sly.open.reward.text: He knows. Told me to carry the heavy pack. Then gave me half his bread. I had a whole speech ready and everything. Here's the shard. Let's see if I can earn the bread.

choices.text: That sounds like a start.

voice.speaker: sly
voice.scene: Open apology or repaired route reward
voice.emotion: A little stunned by kindness. Warm, understated humor.
voice.direction: A little stunned by kindness. Warm, understated humor.
voice.context: The Dungeons below Ruined Keep. The player is freeing captives and will learn Ellis escaped north. No Bladeborn or ending reveal. Open apology or repaired route reward

kd.sly.done.text: I'll stay with the others. No wandering hands. You can stop checking your pockets now. Well... after we leave this prison.

choices.text: Carry the pack, Sly.

voice.speaker: sly
voice.emotion: A cautious return of humor. No second reward.
voice.direction: A cautious return of humor. No second reward.
voice.context: The Dungeons below Ruined Keep. The player is freeing captives and will learn Ellis escaped north. No Bladeborn or ending reveal. Brief repeat interaction

effects.title: The missing names
effects.text: The list assigns prisoners to the west cells, but the beds are empty. Old service marks continue behind those rooms. Find where the prisoners were moved.

effects.title: A wall built later
effects.text: The floor stones and paired service marks lead behind the empty west cells. A narrow door was covered by newer stone.

effects.title: Get them to the lift
effects.text: The hidden prisoners are free. They will gather at the central lift. Its marked weights need a total of four. Read their confiscated papers before leaving.

effects.title: Ellis escaped north
effects.text: The prisoners confirm the note: Professor Ellis escaped toward Frostfell before transport. The Legion wants him for his knowledge of the King’s early research. First, make the way out safe for this group.

effects.title: Lift load plate
effects.text: UPPER SHELTER: 4. Hook weights that add up to four. A hooked weight is raised and pale green; a loose one stays dark. The eastern service stairs connect both landings.

effects.title: The group reached shelter
effects.text: The lift carried everyone up. The Fallen still blocks the final release hall. You can keep exploring before entering that hall.

effects.title: Two loads, one safety bar
effects.text: The lower plate shows two steps: set the safety bank to 5, then lock its bar. Set the separate lower bank to 8. The bar holds the first load while the lower lock releases.

effects.title: The keepsake is back
effects.text: The picture is safe in its owner’s bundle. Speak to Sly once the group reaches the upper shelter.

effects.title: Marks above the water
effects.text: Pairs of scratches follow the old dry route. Three scratches mark unused turns. The water runs back toward the entrance. No one in the cells mentioned this passage.

effects.title: Dry store
effects.text: A rare chest piece was kept above the floodwater. The store is empty now.
